project_type: Full-stack AI email outreach agent - FastAPI backend + Next.js 16 frontend + Celery workers
build_system: pip + npm, Docker Compose for multi-service orchestration
test_framework: No tests exist currently. Backend should use pytest, frontend should use TypeScript compilation check.
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
test_command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (once tests exist) && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps and run uvicorn to confirm startup. 2. Install frontend deps and run 'npm run build' for type/build checks. 3. Run pytest for backend tests.
setup_instructions: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install
environment_constraints: Sandbox environment with limited network. Focus on code correctness and logic. No Docker daemon available for container builds. No Redis available for Celery testing.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Follow existing patterns in the codebase.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in app/api/, services in app/services/, SQLAlchemy models, Pydantic schemas. Frontend: Next.js App Router with 'use client' pages, TanStack Query hooks in lib/hooks.ts, shadcn/ui components in components/ui/, Axios API client.
directory_structure: Root: docker-compose.yml, .env.example, README.md, documentation.md. backend/: FastAPI app in app/ with api/, services/ subdirs. frontend/: Next.js 16 app in src/ with app/, components/, lib/ subdirs.
